info.name: KHR_LIGHT_QUAD
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension, trimmed to what this device implements. Omitted registry parameter: 'intensityDistribution'/'c0' (photometric distributions are not implemented; see task 17). 'side' supports all three registry values; with 'both' each face emits the resolved radiance, so 'intensity'/'power' are interpreted per face (total flux doubles). LIMITATION: 'intensity'/'power' are converted to radiance using the light's LOCAL edge area at commit time, so they are only exact for unscaled instances; 'radiance' is exact under any instance transform. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: overall amount of light emitted in a direction in W/sr (converted using the local edge area; exact only for unscaled instances)

parameters.name: power
parameters.description: overall amount of light energy emitted in W (converted using the local edge area; exact only for unscaled instances)

parameters.name: radiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the light source in a direction in W/sr/m^2

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: light emitting sides of the quad
